name: Marker scribble: circle, arrow, note
what: A hand-drawn marker circle draws itself around your head, an arrow follows from a short note (“me”) that pops in at the upper right, and three marker crosses pop around; the lines boil like a hand-drawn cartoon while it holds, then wipe away. The Editor pins it to the face every frame.
origin: MotionLab's own build of a common in-shot effect for talking-head videos: a marker circle and arrow drawn around the speaker’s head with a short note (2026-10-27)
motion: f0-f16 the marker loop draws itself around the head (S-curve), once round and a little past its start; f13-f23 the arrow draws from the note to the loop (decelerating), its head f22-f26; f20-f29 the note pops in (0.7 to 1 with an overshoot), tilted -8 deg; f24 / f27 / f30 three crosses pop (8 f each, overshoot); the lines and the note boil on twos while it holds; the last 12 f the note and crosses shrink away (accelerating) and the lines un-draw from their start (S-curve, f-10 to f-1). The loop is 2 x 2.6 of the layout's 4.4-wide visible area: snap w 4.2 makes it about 1.9 face widths wide

tracks.name: arrow draws
tracks.what: the arrow from the note to the loop, then its head

tracks.name: crosses pop
tracks.what: three marker crosses pop one after another

tracks.name: wipe away
tracks.what: the note and crosses shrink, the lines un-draw
